label: preparing
what: A privately funded jubilee celebration, very likely for my forty years as mayor, is being prepared for eighteen hundred in the great hall under cover of a lighting inspection. Baker and Builder are arranging bread supplies with secrecy requested until eighteen; Innkeeper coordinates hall hospitality, and Freight has provided emeralds and is carrying bread. Secretary knowingly assists with the appointment and respects their discretion, though her knowledge of the full plan is uncertain.
